text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: page fired for service=llm-serving (severity: high) - 128 alerts in 90s, grouping by fingerprint=prefix-err-502

pagerduty-bot: Automatically triggered escalation: page -> oncall@mike_oncall -> escalation-policy-1

mike_oncall: acked

mike_oncall: seeing a paging storm. lots of duplicates from the request-batcher route. 502s spiking in eu-west-1

anya_prod: confirmed 502s from customers using embeddings endpoint. symptom: downstream KV store timeouts, then 502s returned by runtime

lee_support: we got 3 support tickets in the last 5m citing timeouts+502 when calling /v1/embeddings, account ids: 9981, 1204, 4430

sara_sre: jumping on this with you @mike_oncall. rough plan: 1) suppress duplicate pages, 2) mitigate customer impact (fallbacks/scale), 3) root cause triage

incident-bot: Suggested action: `--silence` duplicate alerts for fingerprint=prefix-err-502 for 30m. To confirm run: ```/incidents silence --service llm-serving --fingerprint prefix-err-502 --duration 30m --reason "paging storm: dedupe"```

mike_oncall: running silence now

mike_oncall: /incidents silence --service llm-serving --fingerprint prefix-err-502 --duration 30m --reason "paging storm: dedupe"

incident-bot: OK: silence created id=sd-77b2 ttl=30m. Future identical alerts will be grouped and will not page. PagerDuty escalation suppressed for grouped alerts.

tim_ops: we should still keep a single consolidated pager for the underlying issue. set incident priority to P1 if customer impact confirmed

anya_prod: customer impact = degraded embedding responses (timeouts -> 502). affect ~2.3% of production traffic in eu-west-1, some tail latency on host pool. recommend P2->P1 if it grows

lee_support: flagging high-value customers in the thread so SREs know: acct 9981 is enterprise with Dedicated contract

sara_sre: mitigation steps in progress:
- temp route: route embeddings to fallback-model-v2 (less accurate but lower mem) for eu-west-1
- scale up dedicated pool for embeddings by +2 nodes (estimated 15% capacity gain)
- increase per-route rate limit to reduce burstiness (throttle noisy clients)
- disable continuous batching on affected hosts to reduce KV pressure

mike_oncall: executing route change now: `rtrctl promote fallback-model-v2 --route embeddings --region eu-west-1`

incident-bot: route promotion queued: job=job-6542. Estimated completion: 18s

incident-bot: route promotion done: job=job-6542 status=success

mike_oncall: scaling dedicated pool: `infractl scale pool:embeddings-dedicated +2 --region eu-west-1`

pagerduty-bot: NOTE: silent grouping is active; single consolidated PD alert remains -> incident 51234

tim_ops: applying throttles: `rlctl set --route embeddings --burst 200 --rate 50` 

sara_sre: disabled continuous batching on hosts: host-23, host-24, host-26. command: `runtimectl set-batching --host host-23 --mode manual`

incident-bot: autosuppression: created rule suppress_if_rate>100p/m AND fingerprint=prefix-err-502 -> suppression-window=10m

mike_oncall: after mitigations: error rate down from 12% -> 3% over last 5m. tail latency improved. customer tickets updated.

anya_prod: still seeing a handful of enterprise calls fail; we're manually routing a few sessions to dedicated fallbacks. working with support to triage customer 9981

lee_support: sent message to 9981: "We're investigating intermittent 502s for embeddings in eu-west-1. Temporary mitigations in place; we'll follow up in 30m." :white_check_mark:

sara_sre: good call on suppressing the page storm. notes for post-incident housekeeping:
- keep suppression rule but narrow to fingerprint + signature to avoid hiding new issues
- create a PD maintenance window for the next 1h to avoid escalation loops while we patch
- mark duplicates closed and annotate incident 51234 with dedupe rule id=sd-77b2

mike_oncall: can someone own the follow-up RCA? I can do initial timeline but need deeper runtime trace analysis from @sara_sre

sara_sre: I can own the RCA. will pull runtime traces and kernel logs. assigning: sara_sre (RCA owner), mike_oncall (timeline), anya_prod (customer comms)

incident-bot: housekeeping actions executed:
- grouped 128 alerts into incident 51234
- created suppression sd-77b2 TTL=30m
- PD escalation suppressed for grouped alerts
- posted link to incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/51234 (internal)

tim_ops: ops note: we should add a dedupe key which includes service+route+error-code so noisy clients don't create cross-route storms

mike_oncall: agreed. ticketing: CR: infra-2371 to add `dedupe_key = service|route|err_code|fingerprint` on incident-broker

anya_prod: also recommend an automated fallback rule: if error rate > 8% for 2m then route to fallback-model and raise metric alert (no paging)

sara_sre: logging next steps in incident doc and scheduling RCA sync in 45m. Thanks all.

lee_support: closing support tickets for 3 customers after manual verification. will reopen if they report more errors

mike_oncall: handing off to @sara_sre for the night. I'm headed out. Summary: mitigations applied, error rate falling, suppression in place, RCA assigned.

sara_sre: ack handoff. will keep watch and update.

incident-bot: thread auto-archived in 2h if no activity.

mike_oncall: :thumbsup: great work everyone
